title: The Slow-Mo Entrance
trend: TikTok/Reels 'slow-motion entrance' trend (friends take turns making dramatic slow-mo walk-ins in ordinary places) — on New Engen's October 2026 US TikTok trends list
intro: we took this way too seriously
youtube_title: We tried the slow-mo entrance trend at the office and it went so wrong 🎬
description:
Friday office video: one slow-motion entrance each. Marvin brought soup, Denise brought wind, and nobody read the door.

lines.text: Okay team. Friday video. Slow motion entrances. Like a movie.
Like a movie about an accountant?
Like a movie where the accountant is the hero.
I have waited eleven years for that sentence.
And I am judging. I have seen all of you on Mondays.
I am only here for the rug.
Marvin, you're first. Walk in like the wind is on your side.
The wind has never been on my side.
He is walking very slowly. Like a man who lost his car.
Marvin. The phone does the slow part.
Then why did I practice in the parking garage for an hour?
Security has a video of that. It is their favorite video.
I also brought a hot coffee. For drama.
That is not coffee. That is soup.
It was the only hot thing in the kitchen.
Okay! Very bold. Very soup. Next!
My turn. I need wind. Hair blowing. Main character energy.
We don't have a fan.
I have a fan in my back. For emergencies.
Warning. It smells like warm paper and regret.
Oh. Oh, that is hot. Why is it so hot?
I am a copier. I am always this hot. Nobody ever asks.
Your hair looks amazing. It also looks like it's leaving.
Something smells like toast.
That is me. That is how I say I love you.
Turn it off! Tell me my eyebrows are fine.
Your eyebrows are still in the building.
Final shot. Group heist entrance. We're stealing the good chair.
Bold. Linda has sat in that chair since two thousand nine.
Linda is on vacation.
Linda always knows.
Ready? Three. Two. One. Walk.
Ow.
It is a pull door. It has always been a pull door. It says pull.
Or so much better. Pain is cinema.
I have watched people push that door for nine years. Best show.
That's a wrap. Let's watch it back. In glorious slow motion.
Play it. I need to see the soup.
Oh no.
Why is everyone so fast?
Denise. That is not slow motion. That is time lapse.
I look like a squirrel late for a meeting.
My hair is going up and down like a car wash.
You walked into the door four times in one second. It is beautiful.
Too late. It is in the office group chat. Linda replied.
What did Linda say?
She said, is that my chair. Then she said, best video this office has ever made.
So we're heroes.
Wait. Barkley never did his entrance.
I am doing it right now.
He has been crossing the room since lunch.
That's real slow motion. No phone needed.
It is not a trend. It is my knees.
Next Friday's video. Starring Barkley.
I will need a rug. And Linda's chair.
